basic_info.description: Charming remodeled condo in the beautiful Hamilton Building with 24 hour door person.  Private exterior views of San Francisco, brand new kitchen (quartz counters, all new cabinets, wonderful tile backsplash and floor complete with stainless steel appliances).  Walk-in closet, ceiling fan, new carpet and interior paint throughout.  New fixtures in bathroom along with original period details tile floor and walls, and newly refinished bathtub.  This building is a like a piece of fine art, with soaring high ceiling in the wonderful lobby with grand piano and high-end finishes.  Views are stunning from the stylish roof-top deck.  You will love this well-preserved time capsule.  Close to transportation, restaurants and city night life.  Complete with fitness center & HOA costs include heat, water, electricity & trash.
